$comment: CUSTOMIZE the Node invocation only for your installed runtime. PascalCase event names select the documented VS Code-compatible payload format; they do not prove host parity. Register each event once. SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit allow 90 seconds for live task/plan resolution; PreToolUse remains 10 seconds and must stay fast. Command-hook timeouts are fail-open, including PreToolUse, so no universal write denial is claimed when authorization times out. Same-owner recovery is required after an interrupted resolver. Prompt hook output is not a universal stop control. Stop dispatch uses the explicit task role. Local hook records are not hosted acceptance evidence.
